description: A delay line read with third-order Lagrange interpolation, built for waveguide and Karplus-Strong voices, flanging and chorus, with a second output tapped part way along the line

params.text: Shortens the delay by 0 to 16 sample periods, which compensates for the one sample every patch cable in the feedback loop adds
Sets the delay to one cycle of a pitch, -4 to 4 volts around C4 at 261.63Hz, and appears while the menu is set to Pitch
Sets the delay directly, 0.1ms to 1 second, and appears while the menu is set to Time
Taps the delay line for the Pickup output, 0 at the point the signal enters the line and 1 at the point it leaves
Attenuates and inverts the pickup position CV, which at the full setting moves the tap across the whole line for 10V
Scales the signal at the FBack input, 0 to 0.999, before it is added to the delay input
Switches the feedback between being added to the input and being subtracted from it, and lights the lamp for the sign in force

inputs.text: Sets the delay: read a volt per octave around C4 in Pitch mode, and in Time mode every volt lengthens the delay by a fifth of the knob setting
Moves the pickup tap along the delay line, scaled by the trimpot under the Pk Pos knob
The signal fed into the delay line
The signal returned into the delay line, scaled by the feedback trimpot and given the sign of the plus-minus button; nothing is routed back inside the module, so a cable is needed

outputs.text: The signal tapped part way along the delay line, at the point set by Pk Pos
The delayed signal, interpolated between samples so the delay can be a fraction of one, and limited to -20V to 20V

notes: Nothing is fed back inside the module: a Karplus-Strong voice needs the Out jack patched back to the FBack jack
The maker's example patch runs that feedback path through a filter and a DC blocker before it returns to FBack
menu: Delay specification... — chooses whether the Delay knob is read as a Pitch, one cycle long, or as a Time in milliseconds
